ConnectionConfig.Title: Connection Configuration
ConnectionConfig.AccessTokenHelper: Used for the next connection. A generated test-user token remains visible and copyable here.
ConnectionConfig.HubUrlHelper: Select the SignalR hub to connect to.
ConnectionConfig.TestUserConnectHelper: Creates a random test-user token, fills the token field, and connects to the selected hub.
ConnectionConfig.Intro: Choose a hub and connect this browser.
ConnectionConfig.DraftHubHelper: Changing this selection prepares the next connection. Reconnect to apply it.
ConnectionConfig.TestUserUnavailable: This host does not offer test-user tokens. Supply an access token when the hub requires authentication.
ConnectionConfig.NoHubs: No hubs are mapped in this host. Refresh after the host configuration changes.
ConnectionConfig.NotLoaded: Hub metadata has not been captured yet.
ConnectionConfig.LoadFailed: Hub metadata could not be read. Refresh to try again.
ConnectionConfig.LoadFailedRetained: Hub metadata could not be refreshed. The previous captured catalog is still shown.

ConnectionStatus.Title: Connection Status
ConnectionStatus.AnonymousWarning: This browser connection was not observed in the latest successful capture of this host's connection registry. The registry tracks authenticated connections from Monica tracking hubs. Absence alone does not establish the connection's authentication status.

ConnectedUsers.Title: Authenticated connections ({0})
ConnectedUsers.Empty: No tracked connections in this snapshot.
ConnectedUsers.ClaimsEmpty: This user does not have any claims.
ConnectedUsers.Scope: Host registry snapshot. Each row is one tracked connection; a user can have multiple connections.
ConnectedUsers.EmptyHelp: Anonymous browser connections are not recorded in this registry. Refresh to capture current host connections.
ConnectedUsers.NotLoaded: The server registry has not been captured yet.
ConnectedUsers.LoadFailed: The server registry could not be read. Refresh to try again.
ConnectedUsers.LoadFailedRetained: The server registry could not be refreshed. The previous captured snapshot is still shown.
ConnectedUsers.NoMatchesHelp: Search covers complete connection and user IDs, user names, and supplied claim types and values.
ConnectedUsers.FrozenHint: These details are a detached snapshot of the selected connection. Refreshing or disconnecting does not change this evidence.
ConnectedUsers.ClaimsNote: Repeated values for the same claim type are combined by the host.

SendDiagnostics.Title: Server send evidence
SendDiagnostics.NotLoaded: Send diagnostics have not been loaded.
SendDiagnostics.Disabled: Send metrics are disabled. Enable ModuleSignalROption.EnableSendMetrics to capture Monica-observed send counters.
SendDiagnostics.Empty: No observed send activity has been recorded yet.
SendDiagnostics.EvidenceNote: Counts describe Monica-observed server-to-client send tasks. Task completion does not confirm receipt by a client.
SendDiagnostics.LoadFailed: Send evidence could not be loaded. Try refreshing again.
SendDiagnostics.RefreshFailed: The latest refresh failed. The last successful snapshot remains visible below.
SendDiagnostics.RankedMethods: Showing {0} of {1} methods, ranked by in-flight tasks and then longest observed duration.
SendDiagnostics.TargetScope: Target rows group explicit selectors or exclusions; their counts are not recipient counts.

MethodListener.Title: Browser callbacks
MethodListener.Empty: The current catalog does not contain any callback names to register.
MethodListener.EmptyEnabled: No browser callbacks are enabled. Use Manage listeners to choose names from the catalog.
MethodListener.ContractHelp: Register client callback names from this catalog. A callable hub method does not guarantee that the server will send a callback with the same name or signature.
MethodListener.ConnectHelp: Connect this browser to enable or disable callback registrations. Captured counts remain visible while disconnected.

MethodInvoker.Title: Invoke a hub method
MethodInvoker.NoParameters: This method does not require any parameters.

HelperText.String: String value. Enter plain text directly.
HelperText.Double: Double-precision number. Use a decimal point, for example: 123.45
HelperText.Float: Single-precision number. Use a decimal point, for example: 123.45
HelperText.Bool: Boolean value: true/false, 1/0, yes/no, y/n, or on/off. Case is ignored.
HelperText.DateTime: Date and time parsed with invariant culture, for example: 2026-10-10T12:00:00Z
HelperText.Array: Bracketed arrays or objects are parsed as JSON, for example: ["item1","item2"]. Other text is passed unchanged.
HelperText.List: Bracketed arrays or objects are parsed as JSON, for example: ["item1","item2"]. Other text is passed unchanged.
HelperText.Complex: Type {0}: bracketed arrays or objects are parsed as JSON. Other text is passed unchanged.

ErrorText.Bool: Use true/false, 1/0, yes/no, y/n, or on/off.
ErrorText.DateTime: Enter a valid date and time.

MethodInvoker.Help: Choose a callable method from the current catalog and enter its arguments.
MethodInvoker.Empty: The current catalog does not contain any callable methods.
MethodInvoker.DefaultsHelp: Empty fields use parser defaults: zero for numbers, false for booleans, the current UTC time for DateTime, an empty GUID for Guid, and empty text for other types.
MethodInvoker.ConnectHelp: Connect this browser before invoking a method. Argument drafts remain available while disconnected.

MessageSender.Title: Quick Message Sender
MessageSender.Contract: The connected hub must expose this method with two string arguments.
MessageSender.DraftHelp: Press Enter to send. Your draft stays after sending.
MessageSender.ConnectHelp: Connect to a hub to send. Your draft stays after sending.

MessageLog.Title: Session trace
MessageLog.Help: This session retains the latest 1,000 events. Clearing the trace also resets the received-message counter.
MessageLog.Empty: No events have been recorded. Connect to a hub or invoke a method to start the trace.
